notes: Sheet is rotated (north arrow points up-right); Elmore runs diagonally across the top, Dreman across the bottom left, Spring Grove Av. across the bottom right. Bare printed names kept bare: ELMORE, DIRR, SPAETH (spelled SPAETH here and on the key map), DREMAN; FOLLETT ALLEY and DIRR ALLEY printed in full. All points computed from fitted block lines (not water pipes). Measured widths: Elmore 50, Dirr 50, Spaeth 50, Dirr Alley 16, Follett Alley 12, Colerain 60-61, Dreman 41 ft. Follett Alley, Dirr, Dirr Alley and Spaeth all stop at Elmore (north line of Elmore continuous) and at Dreman / Spring Grove (T's). Elmore/Follett Alley centre (586,177) lies near the top edge; Elmore's north line is just off the paper there. Spring Grove Av.: printed 60' near Colerain, but the drawn lines between the bridge and Colerain are ~70 ft apart (420 px); centre taken midway. West of the bridge there is no south line (open creek bank), so the centreline there is the north line offset by the same half-width (35 ft); with 30 ft the Dreman junction would move to (3503,7457). The north line also bends slightly at Spaeth. The 60 ft BRIDGE across Mill Creek leaving the south side of Spring Grove at x~4640-5050 is unnamed on this sheet; on the key map it leads south into sheet 603 where the street is labelled only 'AV.' (the rest of the label is hidden under the big '603') - most likely Spring Grove Avenue itself turning south over the creek, in which case the stub west of the bridge to Dreman is the old line joining Dreman. Recorded as '? (bridge over Mill Creek)'. Dreman meets the Spring Grove stub at the bottom left (3538,7475); a line runs on SW from the Dreman south corner (3286,7482) along the creek bank onto sheet 608 (no name, no pipe; not recorded). Colerain / Spring Grove: Colerain runs straight down the right side (north arm centre x~6150 at Elmore, ~6127 near the junction) and continues south over the Colerain bridge (60 ft, centre ~6100 at y 7000); Spring Grove's NE leg leaves the junction toward sheet 612 along the 16" pipe; point is where the Spring Grove (west leg) centreline meets the Colerain centreline. East of Colerain, a block corner at (6283,5610) with a line running ESE to the sheet edge belongs to sheet 612 (no crossing centre on this sheet). Circled numbers (55', 56', 60', 53') are grade elevations, not widths. Scale ~6.04 px/ft.
